items.name: Professional detail and odor treatment
items.description: Full interior and exterior detail, engine bay clean, ozone odor treatment.
items.reason: Clean, fresh-smelling cars photograph better and draw more early bids.

items.name: Replace worn tires
items.description: Current tread is about 4/32". Four mid-tier all-season tires, mounted and balanced.
items.reason: Buyers deduct the full retail price of tires below 5/32", more than this costs you.

items.name: Driver seat bolster repair
items.description: Re-dye and reinforce the worn outer bolster on the driver seat.
items.reason: Small gain, but it removes the only wear item on the condition report.

items.name: Add all-weather mats and cargo liner
items.description: OEM-style all-weather floor mats and a molded cargo liner.
items.reason: Nice to have, but wholesale buyers barely price accessories.

items.name: Window tint
items.description: Ceramic tint on side and rear windows.
items.reason: Tint is a personal preference and some buyers will want it removed.

scenarios.explanation: Fresh tires and a full detail push this RAV4 into the top grade bracket. Dealers pay for frontline-ready inventory, so the work more than pays for itself.
Salvage buyers bid on the car's parts and repair potential, not its presentation. Reconditioning before a salvage sale loses money.
